sources.snippet: After months of experimentation, I am finally happy to release HMNSFW - Extreme Realism This LoRA takes simple prose prompts and turns them into extremely realistic sex scenes with audio and motion. Recommended strength: 0.6-1.0 Sampling settings: I use the fl2va int8 convrot model with Euler/Beta at 18 steps, without Turbo LoRA. I did test this with Turbo LoRA and it works well.
